profile.name: Md. Alimul Huq
profile.tagline: Dissecting malicious code to understand threats and defend systems.
profile.about:
I am a Computer Science & Engineering student passionate about cybersecurity and malware analysis. I specialize in reverse engineering, static and dynamic analysis of malicious samples, and understanding attack techniques to build better defenses.

My journey began with a curiosity about how software works at the lowest level, which led me into the world of threat research, binary analysis, and incident response.
